texts: Option D, increase the LVAD rate, is not appropriate here.
The child is hypoxic and hypercarbic with acidosis, which constricts the pulmonary vessels and loads the right ventricle, and an LVAD can only pump what the right heart delivers.
Speeding the pump empties the left ventricle, shifts the septum to the left and worsens right ventricular function, so pump filling falls further.

The right steps treat the lungs and the right ventricle: a temporary rise of FiO2 to 100 percent, inhaled nitric oxide, a faster ventilator rate to clear carbon dioxide, and an echocardiogram to check the right ventricle, the septum and filling.
In the picture, Vader's control box turned faster empties the red room and drags the party wall over, and is turned back.
Memory hook: when the blue side gasps, do not speed up Vader.
